2.325.5
DataSet.Fields
The DataSet.Fields element specifies a set of fields to include in a DataSet. This element is optional
and is of type Fields.
Following is the parent element of the DataSet.Fields element.
Parent elements
DataSet
The following is the XML Schema definition of the DataSet.Fields element.
 <xsd:element name="Fields" type="FieldsType" minOccurs="0" />
